answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by routing every new identity across a raven-watched bridge of stake-weighted checks. Cloning is blocked because each bridge crossing burns a non-refundable fee, so a flood of fake agents drains the attacker's funds. A public spiral of attestations makes repeated duplicates visible to all peers. Since every forged identity must repay the entry cost, scaling sybils becomes more expensive than any reward it yields.
